shared_elements: carved stone in a pale limestone-like material
quadruped animal shown with head, snout and limbs
animal head in profile with pronounced muzzle
incised grid/hatched texture used as surface patterning on a body
justification: Both are pale stone carvings of animals whose bodies carry incised grid or hatched texturing, and both stack creatures one above another along a vertical axis, which is the most specific correspondence. The decisive difference is technique and format: A is a flat slab covered in shallow low-relief figures arranged in horizontal registers, whereas B is a bulky sculpture in the round with volumetric, projecting limbs and almost no pictorial field.
